item.description:
VoiceClaw Companion 0.1.113

  • Adds GPT-5.4-mini and GPT-5.4-nano as Companion Realtime Voice LLM choices alongside GPT-5.5, Cerebras, and Local Qwen.
  • Aligns Companion Realtime Voice planning with the selected OpenAI LLM instead of hard-coding GPT-5.5.
  • Keeps the HF speech-to-speech runtime readiness and 16 kHz runtime contract intact.

VoiceClaw Companion 0.1.112

  • Corrects Sparkle update ordering with a build number newer than 0.1.110.
  • Stops Companion voice, HF, Qwen, TTS, keep-hot, and Powerhouse prewarming from running automatically at bridge startup.
  • Keeps Powerhouse warming and dependency preparation as explicit user actions.
  • Removes the realtime priority-helper installer path while preserving legacy helper diagnostics.
  • Keeps the default Powerhouse mode at Light.

VoiceClaw Companion 0.1.110

  • Disables automatic Companion voice, HF, Qwen, TTS, keep-hot, and Powerhouse prewarming on startup.
  • Defaults the Powerhouse picker and LaunchAgent configuration to Light mode.
  • Keeps dependency installation, diagnostics, and warming as separate explicit user actions.
  • Removes the priority-helper install option from the Companion UI and diagnostics actions.
  • Preserves the bounded selected-runtime warmup fixes from 0.1.108/0.1.109.
